verdicts.reason: A: 'Spa Utopia' is blown up so far that it sits on top of the dropper bottles and runs into the bottom edge. The 'Weekly SPA items review' subtitle is set huge in bold and competes with the headline, and it sits over the leaves while the brush-stroke panel floats empty in the middle. B: the headline keeps a scale closer to the original but still sits on top of the bottles. The small subtitle lies on the dark leaves and is hard to read, and the brush stroke is again cut off from the text it used to sit behind. B is slightly less broken.
